subtitle: "Réjean Ducharme"

```{r}
#| include: false
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)

# Load reusable functions
source("R/reading_helpers.R")

# Import datasets
books <- read_csv(
  "data/books.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

reading_log <- read_csv(
  "data/reading_log.csv",
  col_types = cols(
    book_id = col_character(),
    date = col_date(),
    page_reached = col_integer()
  )
)

# Identify this book
book_id <- "B001"

# Retrieve its reading history
book_history <- get_book_history(
  books,
  reading_log,
  book_id
)
```

```{r}
#| echo: false

book_header(
  books,
  reading_log,
  book_id
)
```
